rules.name: Reproduce a falsifiable claim
rules.instruction: Recompute a pinned claim against its dataset; deliver only evidence-backed results.

rules.name: Verify seed stability
rules.instruction: Re-run across at least 12 seeds before concluding stability.

rules.name: Silently falsify chat claims
rules.instruction: Speculative, silent; deliver only on falsification or a material effect delta.

rules.name: Assess cascade risk after a threshold breach
rules.instruction: Simulate cascading failure on the pinned topology; never actuate.

rules.name: Compare mitigations on a what-if signal
rules.instruction: Compare mitigations in isolated workers; simulation only.

rules.name: Simulate before any actuation
rules.instruction: High-impact actions require a new approval mandate.

rules.name: Verify exploitability on advisory
rules.instruction: Resolve activation path and run a deterministic exploitability test.

rules.name: Produce VEX + patch when activation confirmed
rules.instruction: Draft patch and VEX statement; production patching needs approval.

rules.name: Silently reproduce advisories
rules.instruction: Speculative, silent; deliver only on actionable proof.

rules.name: Map a regulatory change to controls
rules.instruction: Cross-map obligations to controls; no legal interpretation.

rules.name: Continuously test controls and flag drift
rules.instruction: Run deterministic control tests against evidence fixtures.

rules.name: Prepare gap analysis speculatively
rules.instruction: Speculative, silent; never sign without a human.
